register_shot — 3D feature_register op

• Data kinds: points × points → pose

• Call: import feat_shot; feat_shot.register_shot(src, dst, radius=None, normal_k=16, ratio=0.9, ransac_iters=2000, inlier_thr=None, refine_icp=True, max_kp=400, device='cpu', seed=0) (or ops3d.get("register_shot"))

Usage

Sparse feature matching with SHOT descriptors plus RANSAC rigid pose estimation (the whole pipeline).
